scene unexpectedporntrip1
: There better be a damn good explanation for this.
lines.zh: : 这事最好有个他妈的像样的解释。

lines.en: Needing somewhere private to discuss things that isn’t on the complete opposite side of town (IE: my apartment), I wind up summoning the Apocalypse Squad to the local porn shop.
lines.zh: 我需要一个私密的地方谈事，又不想跑到城镇的另一头（也就是我家），于是我把「末日小队」召到了本地那家色情用品店。

lines.en: Could we have found somewhere better? Probably. But I figured it would be nice to bring Makoto somewhere comfortable so she isn’t too taken aback by all she’s about to hear.
lines.zh: 我们本可以找个更好的地方吗？大概能。但我想把 Makoto 带到一个让她舒服的地方，这样她待会儿要听到的一切就不会太冲击她。

lines.en: And there are few things that make her more comfortable than a building full of rubber penises and fake vaginas that also happens to be her childhood home.
lines.zh: 而能让她舒服的东西没几样比得过一栋塞满橡胶阴茎和假阴道的大楼——顺便，那也是她从小长大的地方。

lines.en: : There is a good explanation for this, I swear. And no, before you go assuming things, it isn’t sexual.
lines.zh: : 这事确实有个像样的解释，我发誓。不，在你开始乱猜之前，不是性方面的。

lines.en: : Great, thanks for clearing that up. Call me a pervert, but meandering through aisles of lubricant and ball-gags gave me a different idea.
lines.zh: : 好，谢谢澄清。算我变态吧，可在一排排润滑液和口塞之间绕来绕去，给我的印象可不是这样。

lines.en: : I mean, it can be sexual if you want. If that’s the case, we can take a short break before getting down to the real reason I asked the two of you to come here.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你想让它变成性方面的也行。如果是那样，我们可以在进入我请你们俩来的真正原因之前，先休息一小会儿。

lines.en: : Out with it.
lines.zh: : 说吧。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip2
: If you insist.
lines.zh: : 既然你坚持。

lines.en: : You know what I meant, you pathetic waste of a human.
lines.zh: : 你知道我是什么意思，你这个可悲的人渣。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip1
: Well, you don’t have to be rude about it.
lines.zh: : 唉，你也不用这么凶吧。

lines.en: : You know, I’m all for a good movie night every once in a while. But I’m not really sure how I feel about this choice of film. Or why we have to do it here when there’s a much bigger TV at my house.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，偶尔搞一次电影之夜我是很赞成的。但我不太确定我对这部片子的选择有什么感想。也不懂为什么非得在这儿看，我家那台电视大多了。

lines.en: : We have to do this here because I encountered something very unexpected just a short while ago.
lines.zh: : 我们非得在这儿，是因为我刚才撞上了一件非常出乎意料的事。

lines.en: : Please keep your new fetishes to yourself. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请把你新发掘的性癖留给自己。谢谢。

lines.en: : Is it true that...you three, like...uhh...how do I even put this?
lines.zh: : 是真的吗……你们三个，就是……呃……我该怎么说？

lines.en: : Makoto knows about the resets.
lines.zh: : Makoto 知道重置的事。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip3
: Makoto knows what? How? This loop’s barely just begun.
lines.zh: : Makoto 知道什么？怎么知道的？这轮循环才刚开始啊。

lines.en: : Well, to say she knows about the resets isn’t exactly accurate. She just...wasn’t changing the topic whenever I brought them up, so I figured I’d call the two of you right away to prove it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说她「知道」重置的事并不完全准确。她只是……在我提起的时候没有岔开话题，所以我想立刻把你们俩叫来证实一下。

lines.en: : You’re not pregnant, are you? Asking for Maya’s sake.
lines.zh: : 你没怀孕吧？替 Maya 问的。

lines.en: : Uhh...no?
lines.zh: : 呃……没有？

lines.en: : Okay. I figured. I just thought I’d make sure. Again, for Maya’s sake.
lines.zh: : 好。我想也是。我只是想确认一下。再说一次，替 Maya 问的。

lines.en: : What do you know? What did he tell you so far?
lines.zh: : 你知道多少？他到目前为止跟你说了什么？

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip4
: Not much...Miku just started repeating the same thing over and over again and...before I knew it, we were here. I’ve got absolutely no idea what any of this is about.
lines.zh: : 不多……Miku 开始一遍又一遍重复同样的话，然后……等我反应过来，我们就在这儿了。我完全不知道这到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: : What do you mean “repeating the same thing over and over again?”
lines.zh: : 「一遍又一遍重复同样的话」是什么意思？

lines.en: : Whenever Sensei brought up the...time stuff.
lines.zh: : 每次 Sensei 提起那个……时间的事。

lines.en: : Makoto tried too. But it was like Miku got stuck in some sort of...interjection loop. Not to be confused with the loops we’re stuck in.
lines.zh: : Makoto 也试过。但 Miku 像是卡进了某种……插话循环。别跟我们卡住的那些循环搞混了。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip5
: It’s not true, is it? Sensei’s very likely just...misunderstanding something, isn’t he? It’s entirely impossible for humans to move through time like you’re suggesting.
lines.zh: : 这不是真的吧？Sensei 大概只是……误会了什么，对吗？人类像你说的那样穿越时间是完全不可能的。

lines.en: : And the idea of a repeating timeline is just-
lines.zh: : 而且时间线会重复这个想法本身就——

lines.en: : It’s true. Though, I have absolutely no clue whatsoever about why you’re suddenly exempt from the same rules that keep everyone else confined to blissful ignorance.
lines.zh: : 是真的。不过我完全不知道为什么你突然不受那条把其他人全关在幸福无知里的规则约束。

lines.en: : But, yet again, I couldn’t come up with a reason why Yumi and Tsuneyo were exempt last time, so...back to the drawing board, I guess.
lines.zh: : 但话说回来，上次我也想不出 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 为什么不受约束，所以……大概又得从头想了。

lines.en: : Huh...yeah...drawing any similarities between the three of them seems almost impossible. Each one of them is wildly different from one another.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊……要在她们三个之间找出什么共同点，几乎不可能。她们每个人之间都天差地别。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip6
: Can one of you two please explain in better terms what’s going on? Is something wrong with Miku? Is something wrong with me?
lines.zh: : 你们俩谁能用更好懂的话解释一下到底怎么回事？Miku 有问题吗？还是我有问题？

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip7
: To say anything is wrong with anyone isn’t entirely accurate as I believe there is a problem with the world itself.
lines.zh: : 说任何人「有问题」都不准确，因为我认为出问题的是这个世界本身。

lines.en: : Every several months, before the school year comes to an end, the four of us, as well as everyone else we know, are sent back to an earlier part of the year in which everything starts anew.
lines.zh: : 每隔几个月，在学年结束之前，我们四个，以及我们认识的所有人，都会被送回这一年里更早的某个时间点，然后一切重新开始。

lines.en: : Except it technically isn’t an earlier part of the year. We just think it is while our city manages to move through time normally.
lines.zh: : 只不过严格来说那不是「更早的某个时间点」。我们只是以为它是，而我们的城市照常在时间中前进。

lines.en: : The seasons still change and the tangible developments in the environment still...well, develop.
lines.zh: : 季节照常更替，环境里那些实在的变化也照常……嗯，变化。

lines.en: : Until recently, I was the only one whose memories carried over from loop to loop. But changes made to the formula of this for unknown reasons have now landed both Ayane and Sensei beside me.
lines.zh: : 直到不久前，我是唯一一个记忆能从一个循环延续到下一个的人。但由于某些未知原因，这个公式发生了变化，现在 Ayane 和 Sensei 也站到了我旁边。

lines.en: : I take it you’ve already realized by now how suspicious it is that what should be a single school year is packed with years' worth of memories, yes?
lines.zh: : 我猜你现在已经意识到有多可疑了吧——本该是单单一学年的时间，却塞满了够好几年份的记忆？

lines.en: : The reason for that is, I think, because of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 至于原因，我想，是因为 Sensei。

lines.en: : He seems to be the anchor for everyone and the fact that his mind isn’t being reset along with the world means the rest of your memories are carrying over as well.
lines.zh: : 他似乎是所有人的锚，而他的心智没有跟着世界一起被重置，这意味着你们其余人的记忆也跟着延续了下来。

lines.en: : It’s a phenomenon I’ve never encountered to this extent before and I imagine it’s only a matter of time until more people like yourself start catching onto this.
lines.zh: : 这是一种我从未见过到这种程度的现象，我想迟早会有更多像你一样的人开始察觉到这件事。

lines.en: : I...what? Huh? But none of that makes any sense.
lines.zh: : 我……什么？哈？可这些一点道理都没有。

lines.en: : Just wait until she gets to the part about everyone turning invisible and how we all have to hug on top of the roof to make things go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 等她讲到所有人变透明、我们还得在屋顶上抱在一起才能让一切恢复正常那部分，你就更懵了。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip8
: Okay. That’s enough. The joke’s over. I don’t get why all three of you decided to mess with me like this, but it’s gone way too far.
lines.zh: : 好了。够了。玩笑开完了。我不懂你们三个为什么决定这么耍我，但这已经太过分了。

lines.en: : I know how it sounds, but it’s not a joke.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来像什么，但这不是玩笑。

lines.en: : The only thing we can do now is dress you up like a shrine maiden and hope for the best.
lines.zh: : 现在我们唯一能做的，就是把你打扮成巫女，然后祈求最好的结果。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip9
: You’re not helping!
lines.zh: : 你这是在帮倒忙！

lines.en: : Makoto, as the newest member of our time travel club that is tentatively named the “Rooftop Apocalypse Squad” I know exactly how confusing this all sounds.
lines.zh: : Makoto，作为我们这个暂定名为「屋顶末日小队」的时间旅行俱乐部的最新成员，我完全清楚这一切听起来有多离谱。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip10
: In fact, parts of it still feel like a dream to me sometimes. But after seeing it with my own eyes, I can promise you it’s not a joke.
lines.zh: : 事实上，有些部分到现在还让我觉得像在做梦。但亲眼见过之后，我可以向你保证这不是玩笑。

lines.en: : Why would I believe you, though? We’re not close or anything. And you’re so obsessed with Sensei that you’d probably just go along with whatever he says anyway.
lines.zh: : 可我为什么要信你？我们又不熟什么的。而且你那么迷恋 Sensei，大概他说什么你都会跟着附和。

lines.en: : Do you really think I would go through with plotting out an extremely elaborate plan just to play a prank on you? I complain when I have to sign my name. This would be way too much effort for me.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会为了捉弄你，去策划一个极其复杂的计划？我连签个名字都要抱怨。这对我的工作量来说太大了。

lines.en: : You’ve toyed with me plenty of times in the past. I wouldn’t put it past you to do something like that again.
lines.zh: : 你过去耍过我很多次了。我再干一次这种事，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip11

: If you don’t believe us, why not try speaking about this to any of the other girls? Worst case scenario is you just get ignored again. Best case, we find more people like you and settle your doubts.
lines.zh: : 如果你不信我们，为什么不拿这事去跟别的女生聊聊？最坏的情况无非又是被无视。最好的情况，我们能找到更多像你这样的人，也能打消你的疑虑。

lines.en: : I’ve got nothing to lose either way.
lines.zh: : 不管哪种我都不亏。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip12
: Maya, be a little more sensitive. This is clearly really scary and weird for Makoto.
lines.zh: : Maya，稍微体贴点。这对 Makoto 来说显然又可怕又奇怪。

lines.en: : It’s weird for all of us. It was weird enough when you wound up on the roof, but for Makoto of all people to get sucked into this as well is all sorts of confusing.
lines.zh: : 对我们所有人来说都奇怪。你当初上屋顶就已经够奇怪了，而偏偏是 Makoto 这种人也被卷进来，更是各种让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : What do you mean “of all people?” How am I supposed to take that?
lines.zh: : 「偏偏是 Makoto」是什么意思？你让我怎么理解这句话？

lines.en: : Beats me. Take it however you want. I’m still trying to wrap my head around this.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。随你怎么理解。我自己都还在消化。

lines.en: : What should we do now? Weren’t we looking for some sort of way to test more reset-centered info? I did my part. It’s your turn now.
lines.zh: : 那我们现在该怎么办？我们不是一直在找某种方法，来测试更多以重置为核心的信息吗？我的部分做完了。现在轮到你了。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip13
: Guys, stop treating Makoto like she’s some sort of experiment. Like yeah, this might help us find out some stuff, but she’s still a normal girl at the end of the day. It’s not like she wanted this.
lines.zh: : 各位，别再把 Makoto 当成某种实验品了。是，这也许能帮我们查出点东西，可她归根到底还是个普通女孩。又不是她自己想这样的。

lines.en: : I’ll care a little more about her “totally real” feelings if she winds up making it to the roof. For now, she’s just one more enigma.
lines.zh: : 等她真上了屋顶，我再来多关心一下她那「完全真实」的感受。现在，她只是又一道谜题。

lines.en: : You mean like how you started caring about my feelings once I made it to the roof? You sure you don’t wanna ask Makoto to abstain from having sex with Sensei for the entirety of this loop too?
lines.zh: : 你是说就像我上了屋顶之后你才开始关心我的感受那样？你确定你不想也让 Makoto 在这一整轮循环里都跟 Sensei 禁欲？

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip14
: W...What?! Sensei and I don’t-
lines.zh: : 什……什么？！Sensei 和我没有——

lines.en: : Oh, come on Makoto. You don’t have to hide it. We already know.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧 Makoto。你不用藏了。我们都知道了。

lines.en: : Sensei even has you shoving a dildo into your mouth as his wallpaper.
lines.zh: : Sensei 甚至把你把假阳具塞进嘴里的照片当壁纸。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip15
: You said you would delete that!
lines.zh: : 你说过你会删了那张的！

lines.en: : I say a lot of things.
lines.zh: : 我说过的话多了。

lines.en: : Maybe you could use a sex toy or five as well if you’re going to be all grumpy like this.
lines.zh: : 你要是这么暴躁，也许也该来一两个性玩具，或者五个。

lines.en: : Well sorry for not having a trillion years to come to terms with the fact that the man I’m in love with is also sleeping with everyone else. No offense, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，我可没几万亿年去接受「我爱上的男人也在跟其他所有人上床」这个事实。无意冒犯，Makoto。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip16
: Oh...uhh...none taken?
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……我不介意？

lines.en: : Then...I guess this means the two of you are also-
lines.zh: : 那么……我猜这意味着你们俩也——

lines.en: : I am. Maya’s too afraid to let Sensei dick her down because she thinks it’ll make his brain ooze out of his ears.
lines.zh: : 我是。Maya 太害怕让 Sensei 用阴茎对她，因为她觉得那会让他的脑子从耳朵里流出来。

lines.en: : That’s...some confidence you’ve got there.
lines.zh: : 那……你还真是有自信啊。

lines.en: : While I am certainly confident, I can assure you that has little to do with it. It is for everyone’s best interest that I do not sleep with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我确实有自信，但我可以保证这跟自信关系不大。我不跟 Sensei 上床，对所有人都是最好的。

lines.en: : It is also important to note that if I did sleep with Sensei and he did not die from it, that he’d no longer want to sleep with either of you ever again. The end.
lines.zh: : 还有一点很重要：如果我真跟 Sensei 上床而他没因此丧命，那他以后就再也不想跟你们任何一个上床了。到此为止。

lines.en: : I like this side of you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你这个样子。

lines.en: : I don’t. Apart from that outburst when Noriko came to class, you’ve always seemed rather...reserved.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢。除了 Noriko 来上课那次你发作之外，你一直显得相当……克制。

lines.en: : That is because my time is better spent on attempting to understand this world. Which, should things go according to plan, may come to involve you in some way.
lines.zh: : 因为我的时间更适合用来尝试理解这个世界。而如果事情按计划走，那可能会在某种程度上也把你卷进来。

lines.en: : And I say that with full knowledge that things rarely ever go according to plan.
lines.zh: : 而我这么说，是充分知道事情很少真的按计划走。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip17
: What is this plan, though? How am I supposed to just carry on with my daily life knowing that I’m doomed to repeat the same school year for the rest of forever?
lines.zh: : 可这个计划是什么？我该怎么在明知自己注定要永远重复同一个学年的情况下，继续过我的日常？

lines.en: : What’s the sense in applying myself if I know there’s no purpose to it?
lines.zh: : 如果我知道这一切毫无意义，那我努力又有什么意义？

lines.en: : Maybe just...don’t apply yourself then?
lines.zh: : 也许就……别努力了？

lines.en: : It’s hard to give you directions when we don’t know if you’re going to remember any of this come the next cycle, but maybe just...hang out on the DL for now?
lines.zh: : 我们都不知道下一个循环你还记不记得这些，所以很难给你具体指示，不过也许就……先低调过一阵子？

lines.en: : Have fun and slack off. Shove some more dildos in your mouth. It’s not like there’s a time limit. The world is your sandbox.
lines.zh: : 玩吧，摸鱼吧。往嘴里再塞几根假阳具。反正又没有时间限制。这个世界就是你的沙盒。

lines.en: : But also know that things might turn really horrible and really scary at any given moment. If they do and you find yourself in a situation like that, come to the rooftop as quickly as possible.
lines.zh: : 但同时也要知道，事情随时可能变得非常可怕、非常吓人。如果真到那一步，而你发现自己陷在那种局面里，就尽快到屋顶去。

lines.en: : Why...the rooftop? What’s so special about that place?
lines.zh: : 为什么……屋顶？那地方有什么特别的？

lines.en: : Probably just a denpa trope. Either way, that’s where you’ll want to be.
lines.zh: : 大概只是个电波系套路。不管怎样，那就是你该去的地方。

lines.en: : Do you have any more questions for now?
lines.zh: : 你还有什么问题要问吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Roughly one thousand of them.
lines.zh: : 有。大概一千个。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, that’s too many.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那太多了。

lines.en: scene black

: But you can take down my number and text several of them to me. I’d much prefer to not spend a second longer in this room when it is evident the two of you have used it for countless sexual excursions.
lines.zh: : 但你可以把我的号码记下来，挑几个发短信给我。既然显然你俩把这屋子用做过无数次性爱，我实在不想在这里多待一秒。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. It hasn’t been that many...
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。也没那么多次……

lines.en: Maya and Makoto exchange contact information before the two senior female members of the Apocalypse Squad head back to the dorms.
lines.zh: Maya 和 Makoto 交换了联系方式，之后末日小队的两位资深女性成员回宿舍去了。

lines.en: And while I’m hesitant to add Makoto to the roster before she even makes it there (If she does make it there) I can’t help but acknowledge the possibility.
lines.zh: 虽然在 Makoto 真上到那儿之前（如果她真上得去的话）我有点犹豫要不要把她加进名单，但我不得不承认这个可能性。

lines.en: I’m not sure what, but there must be something I can do to make sure she doesn’t suffer the same fate as Yumi and Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我不确定是什么，但一定有我能做的事，确保她不会落得跟 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 一样的下场。

lines.en: Makoto deserves to hang onto her memories just as much as the two of them did...and if there’s anything I can do to strengthen her grasp on them, I’ll do it.
lines.zh: Makoto 跟她们俩一样，配得上留住自己的记忆……而只要有什么是我能做的、能让她抓得更牢，我就会去做。

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip18
: So, how do you feel knowing that this world is something out of a sci-fi novel? Excited?
lines.zh: : 那么，知道这个世界像科幻小说里的东西之后，你感觉怎么样？兴奋吗？

lines.en: : Well, to start, my head hurts. And I’m still half-expecting to wake up from this weird dream at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 首先，我头疼。而且我到现在还半期待着随时会从这场怪梦里醒过来。

lines.en: : I can pinch you if you want?
lines.zh: : 想让我掐你一下吗？

lines.en: scene unexpectedporntrip19
: Hah...no. I know this is real. Somehow.
lines.zh: : 哈……不。我知道这是真的。不知怎么就是知道。

lines.en: : It makes literally zero sense and goes against basically everything I have ever read, but there’s some sort of merit to it, if not only for the fact that things aren’t always entirely as they seem.
